At some point by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date 1 BBY">According to {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished1|text=Unfinished Business, Part 1: Gunrunner|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] utilized [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[attack on Praaelon Di]] took place. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the Alliance acquired the resources necessary to start the production of the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which translates to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the attack at [[Mine Shaft 342]], which followed the attack on [[Praaelon Di]], according to {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished3|text=Unfinished Business, Part 3: Shafted!|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}, must have occurred no earlier than in 1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|BBY]].</ref> an '''attack''' on [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Lenc]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] staff was carried out by the [[Arms dealer/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Praaelon Di]] and his allies at [[Mine Shaft 342]] on the<ref name="UB3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished3|text=Unfinished Business, Part 3: Shafted!|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}</ref> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Weldii system/Legends|Weldii system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Weldii III]].<ref name="UB3" />
